item.description: A stabbing at a home on Blaarthemseweg in Eindhoven during the night of Friday, January 16, seriously injured two people.

item.title: Woman stabbed in Son en Breugel drives self to Eindhoven hospital; Suspect arrested
item.description: A 45-year-old woman drove herself to an Eindhoven hospital for treatment after suffering a stab wound in Son en Breugel, according to authorities.

item.title: 19-year-old sentenced to four months for shooting fireworks at police in Schiedam
item.description: A 19-year-old man was sentenced to four months in prison, two of which are suspended, for attacking police officers with a firework launcher on New Year’s Eve in Schiedam.

item.title: AZ axe Maarten Martens; Robin Van Persie faces growing pressure after derby defeat
item.description: AZ has sacked Maarten Martens from the manager position. The Belgian was relieved of his duties after a 3-1 loss to PEC Zwolle on Saturday.

item.title: Police launch fake ticket website to warn against scams
item.description: In an effort to combat ticket fraud, police have launched a mock ticket sales website offering access to in-demand concerts and sporting events, such as football games.

item.title: Riot police intervene in Amsterdam, The Hague after Morocco loses Africa Cup of Nations
item.description: Riot police had to intervene in Amsterdam and The Hague on Sunday night due to unrest following Morocco’s loss in the Africa Cup of Nations final.
